summary.description: One or two concise, player-facing sentences describing the current mechanical effect at this level.

minLevel.description: The class level at which this feature becomes active.

optional.description: Whether this feature is optional (e.g., a choice the player can skip).

choice.description: If this feature involves a player choice, the choice configuration.

bonus-proficiency-1.summary: You gain proficiency with heavy armor.

disciple-of-life-1.summary: Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore hit points, the creature regains additional hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

channel-divinity-preserve-life-2.summary: As an action, you can expend a use of Channel Divinity to heal creatures within 30 feet. You restore a number of hit points equal to five times your cleric level, divided among any number of creatures. This can't restore a creature to more than half its hit point maximum.

blessed-healer-6.summary: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that restores hit points to a creature other than yourself, you regain hit points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

divine-strike-8.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal extra radiant damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

supreme-healing-17.summary: When you would roll dice to restore hit points with a spell, you instead use the highest number possible for each die.

bonus-cantrip-1.summary: You learn the light cantrip if you don't already know it.

warding-flare-1.summary: When you are attacked by a creature within 30 feet that you can see, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll. You can use this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

channel-divinity-radiance-of-the-dawn-2.summary: As an action, you present your holy symbol and dispel magical darkness within 30 feet. Hostile creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a Constitution save or take 2d10 + your cleric level radiant damage.

warding-flare-improved-6.summary: When you use Warding Flare, you can also cause the attacker to take radiant damage equal to your cleric level.

potent-spellcasting-8.summary: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of any cleric cantrip.

corona-of-light-17.summary: You can use an action to emit bright light in a 60-foot radius and dim light for an additional 30 feet. Enemies in the bright light have disadvantage on saving throws against spells that deal fire or radiant damage.

blessings-of-knowledge-1.summary: You learn two languages and gain proficiency with two of the following skills: Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion. Your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks with these skills.

channel-divinity-knowledge-of-the-ages-2.summary: As an action, you can choose a skill or tool. For 10 minutes, you have proficiency with it, and your proficiency bonus is doubled for checks with it.

channel-divinity-read-thoughts-6.summary: As an action, you can read the thoughts of a creature within 60 feet for 1 minute (Wisdom save negates). You can cast suggestion on the target without a spell slot.

potent-spellcasting-8.summary: You add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of any cleric cantrip.

visions-of-the-past-17.summary: You can spend 1 minute meditating to see visions of an object's past or a location's history. You learn one significant event per 10 minutes of meditation.

acolyte-of-nature-1.summary: You learn one druid cantrip and gain proficiency with one of the following skills: Animal Handling, Nature, or Survival.

channel-divinity-charm-animals-and-plant.summary: As an action, you can charm beasts and plants within 30 feet (Wisdom save). They are charmed for 1 minute and are friendly to you and your allies.

dampen-elements-6.summary: When you or a creature within 30 feet takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can use your reaction to grant resistance to that damage type.

divine-strike-8.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal extra cold, fire, or lightning damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

master-of-nature-17.summary: You can command animals and plants as an action. Beasts and plants within 60 feet must obey your commands (Wisdom save to resist).

domain-spells-1.summary: You gain access to domain spells at each level: 1st (fog cloud, thunderwave), 3rd (gust of wind, shatter), 5th (call lightning, sleet storm), 7th (control water, ice storm), 9th (destructive wave, insect plague).

wrath-of-the-storm-1.summary: When you are hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to deal 2d8 lightning or thunder damage to the attacker (Dex save half). You can use this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

channel-divinity-destructive-wrath-2.summary: As an action, you can channel divine energy to deal maximum lightning or thunder damage with a spell or Channel Divinity effect.

thunderbolt-strike-6.summary: When you deal lightning damage to a creature, you can push it 10 feet away from you.

divine-strike-8.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal extra thunder damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

storm-born-17.summary: You gain a flying speed equal to your walking speed when you are not underground or indoors.

blessing-of-the-trickster-1.summary: As an action, you can touch a willing creature to give it advantage on Stealth checks for 1 hour.

channel-divinity-invoke-duplicity-2.summary: As an action, you create an illusory duplicate of yourself within 30 feet. It lasts for 1 minute. You can move it and cast spells through it. You can use a bonus action to switch places with it.

channel-divinity-cloak-of-shadows-6.summary: As an action, you become invisible until the end of your next turn. You can end it early as a bonus action.

divine-strike-8.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal extra poison damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

improved-duplicity-17.summary: When you use Invoke Duplicity, you can create up to four duplicates. You can also cast spells through them.

bonus-proficiency-1.summary: You gain proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

war-priest-1.summary: As a bonus action, you can make one weapon attack. You can use this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier per long rest.

channel-divinity-guided-strike-2.summary: When you make an attack roll, you can use Channel Divinity to gain a +10 bonus to the roll. You can use this after seeing the roll but before the outcome.

war-gods-blessing-6.summary: When a creature within 30 feet makes an attack roll, you can use your reaction to grant it a +10 bonus to the roll.

divine-strike-8.summary: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can deal extra force damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

avatar-of-battle-17.summary: You gain resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

bonus-cantrip-2.summary: You learn one additional druid cantrip of your choice.

natural-recovery-2.summary: During a short rest, you can recover expended spell slots with a combined level equal to half your druid level (rounded up), up to 6th level. You can't use this again until you finish a long rest.

land-stride-6.summary: You can move through nonmagical difficult terrain without extra movement. You can pass through nonmagical plants without being slowed or taking damage.

natures-ward-10.summary: You can't be charmed or frightened by elementals or fey, and you are immune to poison and disease.

natures-sanctuary-14.summary: Beasts and plants must succeed on a Wisdom save before attacking you. On a failure, they must choose a different target or the attack misses.

combat-wild-shape-2.summary: You can use Wild Shape as a bonus action. You can expend a spell slot to regain 1d8 HP per spell level. You can transform into beasts of CR 1/1 or lower.

circle-forms-2.summary: You can transform into beasts of CR 1 or lower. At 6th level, CR increases to your druid level / 3 rounded down.

primal-strike-6.summary: Your attacks in Wild Shape count as magical for overcoming resistance and immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage.

elemental-wild-shape-10.summary: You can expend two uses of Wild Shape to transform into an elemental (air, earth, fire, or water).

thousand-forms-14.summary: You can cast alter self at will without expending a spell slot.

speech-of-the-woods-2.summary: You can communicate with beasts and many fey. You have advantage on Charisma checks to influence them.

spirit-totem-2.summary: As a bonus action, you can summon a spirit totem (Bear, Hawk, or Unicorn) in a 30-foot radius. It grants benefits to allies in the aura. You can use this once per short or long rest.

options.label: Bear
options.description: Allies gain temporary HP and advantage on Strength checks

options.label: Hawk
options.description: Allies gain advantage on ranged attack rolls

options.label: Unicorn
options.description: Allies gain advantage on detection checks and can't be surprised

mighty-summoner-6.summary: Beasts and fey you summon have more hit points and their natural weapons are magical.

faithful-summon-14.summary: If you are reduced to 0 HP or incapacitated, you automatically summon a spirit totem that protects you.

circle-spells-2.summary: You gain access to circle spells at each level: 2nd (chill touch, inflict wounds), 4th (blindness/deafness, gentle repose), 6th (animate dead, gaseous form), 8th (blight, confusion), 10th (cloudkill, contagion).

halo-of-spores-2.summary: You are surrounded by necrotic spores. When a creature within 10 feet takes damage, you can use your reaction to deal 1d6 necrotic damage (increases at 6th, 10th, 14th level).

symbiotic-entity-2.summary: As an action, you can expend a Wild Shape use to gain temporary HP and deal extra necrotic damage with melee attacks for 10 minutes.

fungal-infestation-6.summary: When a Small or larger beast or humanoid dies within 10 feet, you can use your reaction to raise it as a zombie with 1 HP.

spreading-spores-10.summary: You can spread your spores to a 30-foot radius. Creatures in the area take necrotic damage.

fungal-body-14.summary: You are immune to being blinded, deafened, frightened, and poisoned. You are also immune to critical hits unless incapacitated.

star-map-2.summary: You gain a star chart that can be used as a spellcasting focus. You learn the guidance cantrip and can cast guiding bolt once per long rest.

starry-form-2.summary: As a bonus action, you can assume a starry form: Archer (ranged spell attack), Chalice (heal when casting spells), or Dragon (concentration saves, darkvision).

options.label: Archer
options.description: Ranged spell attack dealing radiant damage

options.label: Chalice
options.description: Heal when casting spells

options.label: Dragon
options.description: Advantage on concentration saves, darkvision 60 ft

cosmic-omen-6.summary: When a creature you can see makes an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, you can use your reaction to roll a die and add or subtract the result.

twinkling-constellation-10.summary: You can cast cure wounds, greater restoration, or scrying using your star map without a spell slot.

full-of-stars-14.summary: While in your Starry Form, you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage, and you can fly at your walking speed.

circle-spells-2.summary: You gain access to circle spells: 2nd (burning hands, cure wounds), 3rd (flaming sphere, scorching ray), 4th (fire shield, stone shape), 5th (flame strike, wall of fire).

summon-wildfire-spirit-2.summary: As an action, you can summon a wildfire spirit in a 30-foot radius. It has its own initiative and can teleport. You can use a bonus action to command it.

enhanced-bond-6.summary: Your wildfire spirit's damage increases. When you cast a fire spell, you can add your Wisdom modifier to one damage roll.

cauterizing-flames-10.summary: When your wildfire spirit damages a creature, you can restore hit points to a creature within 30 feet equal to the damage dealt.

blazing-revival-14.summary: When you drop to 0 HP, you can use your reaction to regain half your HP and erupt in flames, dealing fire damage to creatures within 30 feet.

hunters-prey-3.summary: You gain a benefit when you attack your chosen prey: Colossus Slayer (extra damage), Giant Killer (reaction attack), or Horde Breaker (extra attack).

defensive-tactics-7.summary: You gain one of: Escape the Horde (opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage), Multiattack Defense (AC bonus after being hit), or Steel Will (advantage on fear saves).

multiattack-11.summary: You can make one additional attack when you take the Attack action on your turn.

superior-hunters-defense-15.summary: You gain one of: Evasion (Dex save for half damage), Stand Against the Tide (force attacker to hit another), or Uncanny Dodge (reaction to halve damage).

rangers-companion-3.summary: You gain a beast companion that obeys your commands. It acts on your initiative and can take actions on your turn.

exceptional-training-7.summary: Your companion can take the Dash, Disengage, or Help action on your turn without you commanding it. Its attacks count as magical.

bestial-fury-11.summary: Your companion can attack twice when you command it to take the Attack action.

share-spells-15.summary: When you cast a spell targeting yourself, you can also affect your companion if it's within 30 feet.

gloom-stalker-magic-3.summary: You learn additional spells: 3rd (disguise self), 5th (rope trick), 9th (fear), 13th (greater invisibility), 17th (seeming).

dread-ambusher-3.summary: You gain an extra attack on your first turn, and your speed increases by 10 feet. Your first attack deals extra damage.

umbral-sight-7.summary: You have darkvision out to 60 feet. You are invisible to darkvision.

iron-mind-11.summary: You gain proficiency in Wisdom saves. If you already have it, you gain proficiency in Intelligence or Charisma saves.

stalkers-flurry-15.summary: When you miss with an attack on your turn, you can make another attack as part of the same action.

ancestral-protectors-3.summary: When you enter a rage, spectral guardians appear around you. Until the rage ends, the first creature you hit on your turn is marked; that creature has disadvantage on attacks against targets other than you, and the first time it deals damage to another creature, you can use your reaction to reduce that damage by 2d6.

spirit-shield-6.summary: Your spectral guardians protect others. When a creature you can see within 30 feet takes damage, you can use your reaction to reduce that damage by 2d6. This reduction increases to 3d6 at level 10 and 4d6 at level 14.

consult-the-spirits-10.summary: You can cast augury or clairvoyance without using a spell slot or components. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. You can't use this again until you finish a short or long rest.

vengeful-ancestors-14.summary: When you use Spirit Shield to reduce damage, the attacker takes force damage equal to the amount prevented.

battlerager-armor-3.summary: You gain proficiency with spiked armor. While raging and wearing it, you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with your armor spikes dealing 1d4 piercing. When you grapple, the target takes 3 piercing if you hit.

reckless-abandon-6.summary: When you use Reckless Attack while raging, you gain temporary HP equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1).

battlerager-charge-10.summary: You can use a bonus action to dash. If you move at least 20 feet straight toward a creature and hit it with a spiked armor attack, it must succeed on a Strength save or be knocked prone.

spiked-retribution-14.summary: When a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack while you're raging, it takes 3 piercing damage.

form-of-the-beast-3.summary: When you enter a rage, you manifest a natural weapon: bite (1d8 piercing, heal on hit), claws (1d6 slashing, can attack twice as bonus action), or tail (1d8 piercing, reach 10 ft, AC bonus). You choose each rage.

options.label: Bite
options.description: 1d8 piercing; heal HP equal to proficiency bonus on hit

options.label: Claws
options.description: 1d6 slashing; make one additional claw attack as bonus action

options.label: Tail
options.description: 1d8 piercing, reach 10 ft; when hit, add 1d8 to AC vs one attack

bestial-soul-6.summary: Your natural weapons count as magical. You gain a swim speed and climb speed equal to your walking speed. You can hold your breath for 1 hour.

infectious-fury-10.summary: When you hit with a natural weapon, the target must succeed on a Wisdom save or suffer one of two effects: attack an ally, or take 2d6 psychic and you gain advantage against it.

call-the-hunt-14.summary: When you enter a rage, choose allies within 30 feet. They gain 5 temporary HP and can use their reaction to move up to half their speed without provoking opportunity attacks. You gain advantage on attacks against creatures within 5 feet of them.

frenzy-3.summary: When you enter a rage, you can go into a frenzy. For 1 minute, you can make a single melee weapon attack as a bonus action on each turn. When the rage ends, you suffer one level of exhaustion.

mindless-rage-6.summary: You can't be charmed or frightened while raging. If you are already charmed or frightened when you enter a rage, the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage.

intimidating-presence-10.summary: As an action, you frighten a creature within 30 feet that can see and hear you (Wisdom save, DC 8 + proficiency + Cha). The effect lasts until the end of your next turn. On success, the creature is immune for 24 hours.

retaliation-14.summary: When you take damage from a creature within 5 feet, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against it.

storm-aura-3.summary: When you enter a rage, you emanate a 10-foot aura: Desert (fire damage to creatures in aura), Sea (lightning damage to one creature in aura), or Tundra (cold resistance to allies in aura). You choose the environment each rage.

options.label: Desert
options.description: Fire damage to all creatures in aura

options.label: Sea
options.description: Lightning damage to one creature in aura

options.label: Tundra
options.description: Cold resistance for allies in aura

storm-soul-6.summary: You gain resistance matching your Storm Aura: fire (Desert), lightning (Sea), or cold (Tundra). You can breathe underwater (Sea) or ignore extreme heat/cold (Desert/Tundra).

shielding-storm-10.summary: As a reaction when you or an ally in your aura is hit, grant resistance to the attack's damage type until your next turn.

raging-storm-14.summary: Creatures in your aura take damage when they hit you: fire (Desert), lightning (Sea), or cold (Tundra). The damage equals your proficiency bonus.

spirit-seeker-3.summary: You can cast beast sense and speak with animals as rituals. You don't need to prepare them.

totem-spirit-3.summary: Choose a totem animal: Bear (resistance to all damage except psychic while raging), Eagle (dash as bonus action, no opportunity attacks), Wolf (allies have advantage on melee attacks vs creatures within 5 ft), or custom.

options.label: Bear
options.description: Resistance to all damage except psychic while raging

options.label: Eagle
options.description: Dash as bonus action; no opportunity attacks against you while raging

options.label: Wolf
options.description: Allies have advantage on melee attacks vs creatures within 5 ft of you

aspect-of-the-beast-6.summary: You gain a benefit based on your totem: Bear (carrying capacity doubled, advantage on Strength checks), Eagle (vision up to 1 mile, no disadvantage on Perception in dim light), Wolf (track at normal speed, stealth at normal pace).

spirit-walker-10.summary: You can cast commune with nature as a ritual. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability.

totemic-attunement-14.summary: Your totem grants a powerful ability: Bear (when raging, creatures within 5 ft have disadvantage on attacks vs others), Eagle (fly speed = walking speed while raging), Wolf (allies within 5 ft have advantage on melee attacks).

divine-fury-3.summary: When you hit with a weapon attack while raging, the target takes extra necrotic or radiant damage equal to 1d6 + half your barbarian level.

warrior-of-the-gods-3.summary: If you die, spells that restore you to life don't require material components. You also don't need to have died recently.

fanatical-focus-6.summary: When you fail a saving throw while raging, you can reroll it. You must use the new roll. You can't use this again until you finish a long rest.

zealous-presence-10.summary: As a bonus action, you grant advantage on attack rolls and saving throws to up to 10 allies within 60 feet for 1 round. Once used, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

rage-beyond-death-14.summary: While raging, having 0 HP doesn't knock you unconscious. You must still make death saving throws, and you die if you fail three or if your body is destroyed. Your rage ends only when you die or choose to end it.

spirit-seeker-3.summary: You can cast beast sense and speak with animals as rituals. You don't need to prepare them.

totem-spirit-3.summary: Choose a totem animal: Bear (resistance to all damage except psychic while raging), Eagle (dash as bonus action, no opportunity attacks), Wolf (allies have advantage on melee attacks vs creatures within 5 ft), or custom.

options.label: Bear
options.description: Resistance to all damage except psychic while raging

options.label: Eagle
options.description: Dash as bonus action; no opportunity attacks against you while raging

options.label: Wolf
options.description: Allies have advantage on melee attacks vs creatures within 5 ft of you

aspect-of-the-beast-6.summary: You gain a benefit based on your totem: Bear (carrying capacity doubled, advantage on Strength checks), Eagle (vision up to 1 mile, no disadvantage on Perception in dim light), Wolf (track at normal speed, stealth at normal pace).

spirit-walker-10.summary: You can cast commune with nature as a ritual. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability.

totemic-attunement-14.summary: Your totem grants a powerful ability: Bear (when raging, creatures within 5 ft have disadvantage on attacks vs others), Eagle (fly speed = walking speed while raging), Wolf (allies within 5 ft have advantage on melee attacks).

magic-awareness-3.summary: You can sense magic within 60 feet as an action. You learn the school of magic if any. You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

wild-magic-3.summary: When you enter a rage, roll on the Wild Magic table for a random effect. The effect lasts until the rage ends. The table includes effects like teleportation, fear, bonus damage, etc.

bolstering-magic-6.summary: When a creature within 30 feet that you can see makes an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, you can use your reaction to roll a d3 and add it to the roll. You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

unstable-backlash-10.summary: When you take damage while raging, the attacker takes force damage equal to your barbarian level. The attacker must succeed on a Strength save or be pushed 15 feet away and knocked prone.

uncontrolled-magic-14.summary: When you roll on the Wild Magic table, you can roll twice and choose either result. Additionally, when a creature within 30 feet casts a spell, you can use your reaction to force a Wild Magic surge on it (Constitution save negates).

mote-of-potential-3.summary: You can use a bonus action to expend a Bardic Inspiration die to create a Mote of Potential. When a creature within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can use your reaction to roll the Bardic Inspiration die and add it to the roll. You can do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

animating-performance-3.summary: As an action, you can expend a Bardic Inspiration die to animate a Large or smaller nonmagical item within 60 feet. The animated item becomes a construct under your control for 1 hour. It obeys your commands and has statistics based on your level. You can have one animated item at a time.

creative-crescendo-6.summary: You can create multiple items at once with Animating Performance. The number of items equals your Charisma modifier (minimum 1). Each item can be of a different size and type.

masterpieces-of-creation-14.summary: You can create a permanent nonmagical item worth up to 20,000 gp as an action. The item must be of a type you could create with Animating Performance. You can do this once per long rest.

silver-tongue-3.summary: When you make a Charisma (Persuasion) or Charisma (Deception) check, you can treat a roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

unsettling-words-3.summary: As a bonus action, you can expend a Bardic Inspiration die to subtract the roll from a creature's next saving throw within 60 feet. The creature must be able to hear you.

unfailing-inspiration-6.summary: When you roll a Bardic Inspiration die and the result is a 1, you can roll again and use the new roll.

universal-speech-6.summary: You can speak and understand all languages for 1 hour. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

infectious-inspiration-14.summary: When a creature within 60 feet adds your Bardic Inspiration die to a roll and succeeds, you regain that Bardic Inspiration die. You can use this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier per long rest.

mantle-of-inspiration-3.summary: As a bonus action, you can expend a Bardic Inspiration die to grant yourself a wondrous appearance. You gain 5 temporary HP, and each creature of your choice within 60 feet that can see you gains 5 temporary HP. Until the start of your next turn, each creature that ends its turn in the aura can use its reaction to move up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

enthralling-performance-3.summary: You can perform for 1 minute to charm up to 5 humanoids within 60 feet who can see and hear you (Wisdom save). They idolize you for 1 hour, regarding you as a friendly acquaintance.

mantle-of-majesty-6.summary: You can cast command as a bonus action without expending a spell slot. You can do this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier per long rest. Creatures that fail their save are charmed for 1 minute.

unbreakable-majesty-14.summary: You gain an aura of majesty for 1 minute. Any creature that hits you with an attack must succeed on a Charisma save or take psychic damage and have the attack miss. You can use this once per long rest.

bonus-proficiencies-3.summary: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

cutting-words-3.summary: When a creature within 60 feet makes an attack roll, ability check, or damage roll, you can use your reaction to expend a Bardic Inspiration die and subtract the roll from the creature's roll. You can do this after seeing the roll but before knowing if it succeeds.

additional-magical-secrets-6.summary: You learn two spells of your choice from any class. They count as bard spells for you but don't count against your spells known.

peerless-skill-14.summary: When you make an ability check, you can expend a Bardic Inspiration die and add it to the roll. You can do this after rolling but before knowing the result.

guiding-whispers-3.summary: You learn the guidance cantrip. When you cast it, you can target a creature within 60 feet.

spiritual-focus-3.summary: You can use a spiritual focus (candle, crystal ball, skull, or tarokka deck) as a spellcasting focus. When you cast a spell that deals damage or restores HP, you can roll a d6 and add it to one damage or healing roll.

tales-from-beyond-6.summary: You can reach out to spirits to gain a tale. When you use your Bardic Inspiration, you can choose a tale from the Spirits table. Each tale grants a different benefit. You can use this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

options.label: Clever Fox
options.description: The target gains a bonus to AC and Dexterity saves

options.label: Dragon
options.description: The target deals extra fire damage on attacks

options.label: Giant
options.description: The target gains temporary HP and extra melee damage

options.label: Hero
options.description: The target gains temporary HP and advantage on saves

options.label: Lover
options.description: The target gains advantage on Charisma checks

options.label: Martyr
options.description: The target gains resistance to all damage

options.label: Phantom
options.description: The target gains resistance to necrotic and poison, and can move through creatures

options.label: Rogue
options.description: The target gains sneak attack and advantage on Dex checks

options.label: Sage
options.description: The target gains advantage on Int checks and can cast a wizard cantrip

options.label: Sorcerer
options.description: The target gains a metamagic option and sorcery points

options.label: Warlock
options.description: The target gains an eldritch invocation and a warlock spell

options.label: Wizard
options.description: The target gains a wizard spell and Arcane Recovery

spiritual-focus-14.summary: When you roll on the Tales from Beyond table, you can roll twice and choose either result. When you use your Spiritual Focus, you can roll a d12 instead of a d6 for the bonus.

improved-critical-3.summary: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

remarkable-athlete-7.summary: You add half your proficiency bonus (rounded up) to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution checks you aren't proficient in. Your running long jump distance increases by your proficiency bonus.

additional-fighting-style-10.summary: You learn a second Fighting Style option from the Fighter class list.

superior-critical-15.summary: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

survivor-18.summary: At the start of each of your turns, you regain hit points equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier if you have at least 1 HP and are below half your hit points.

combat-superiority-3.summary: You learn three maneuvers of your choice. You have four superiority dice (d8) that fuel them. You regain all expended dice on a short or long rest. You learn two more maneuvers at 7th, 10th, and 15th level.

student-of-war-3.summary: You gain proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

know-your-enemy-7.summary: When you observe a creature for 1 minute, you learn its capabilities relative to yours: ability scores, hit points, class levels, and more.

improved-combat-superiority-10.summary: Your superiority dice become d10s. You learn two more maneuvers.

relentless-15.summary: When you roll initiative and have no superiority dice, you regain one.

spellcasting-3.summary: You learn two wizard cantrips and two 1st-level wizard spells (abjuration and evocation). You are a 1/3 caster. Your spellcasting ability is Intelligence.

weapon-bond-3.summary: You can perform a 1-hour ritual to bond with up to two weapons. You can't be disarmed of them, and you can summon them to your hand as a bonus action.

war-magic-7.summary: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

eldritch-strike-10.summary: When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you have advantage on the next saving throw it makes against your spells before the end of your next turn.

arcane-charge-15.summary: When you use Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

improved-war-magic-18.summary: When you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

manifest-echo-3.summary: As a bonus action, you can manifest an echo of yourself in an unoccupied space within 15 feet. It has AC 14 + proficiency, 1 HP, and uses your saving throws. It lasts until you dismiss it or it's destroyed. You can use a bonus action to swap places with it.

unleash-incarnation-3.summary: When you take the Attack action, your echo can make the attack instead of you.

echo-avatar-7.summary: You can transfer your consciousness to your echo for 10 minutes. You can see and hear through it, and it can make attacks.

shadow-martyr-10.summary: When a creature you can see within 30 feet is attacked, you can use your reaction to teleport your echo to that space and make the attack target your echo instead.

reclaim-potential-15.summary: When your echo is destroyed, you gain temporary HP equal to 2d6 + your Constitution modifier. You can do this once per long rest.

legion-of-one-18.summary: You can create two echoes instead of one. They can act simultaneously.

bonus-proficiency-3.summary: You gain proficiency with one of the following skills: Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion. Alternatively, you learn one language.

born-to-the-saddle-3.summary: You have advantage on saves to avoid falling off your mount. If you fall, you land on your feet if you fall less than 10 feet. Mounting or dismounting costs only 5 feet of movement.

unwavering-mark-3.summary: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can mark it. The mark lasts until the end of your next turn. A marked creature has disadvantage on attacks against others, and you can make a special opportunity attack against it.

warding-maneuver-7.summary: When you or a creature within 5 feet is hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to add 1d8 to its AC. If the attack still hits, you can force the attacker to reroll with disadvantage.

hold-the-line-10.summary: Creatures provoke opportunity attacks when they move 5 feet or more within your reach. Your opportunity attacks stop their movement for the turn.

vigilant-defender-15.summary: You can take a special reaction on each creature's turn (except your own) to make an opportunity attack.

ferocious-charger-18.summary: When you move at least 10 feet straight toward a creature and hit it with a melee attack, you can knock it prone.

open-hand-technique-3.summary: When you hit a creature with a Flurry of Blows attack, you can knock it prone, push it 15 feet, or prevent reactions until your next turn.

wholeness-of-body-6.summary: As an action, you can regain hit points equal to three times your monk level. You must finish a long rest before using this again.

tranquility-11.summary: After a long rest, you gain the effect of the sanctuary spell (DC 8 + proficiency + Wisdom). It ends if you attack or cast a harmful spell.

quivering-palm-17.summary: When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike, you can spend 3 ki to force a Constitution save. On failure, the creature drops to 0 HP. On success, it takes 10d10 necrotic damage.

shadow-arts-3.summary: You learn the minor illusion cantrip and can cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace, and silence by spending ki points.

shadow-step-6.summary: As a bonus action in dim light or darkness, you can teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space you can see in dim light or darkness.

shadow-arts-improved-6.summary: You can cast darkness, darkvision, pass without trace, and silence without spending ki points.

opportunist-17.summary: When a creature within 5 feet is hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against the attacker.

disciple-of-the-elements-3.summary: You learn elemental disciplines that let you cast spells by spending ki points. You know two disciplines and learn more at higher levels.

elemental-attunement-6.summary: You can spend 1 ki to create harmless sensory effects related to your chosen element.

elemental-mastery-17.summary: You can spend 5 ki to cast a 5th-level elemental spell without material components.

touch-of-death-3.summary: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a melee attack, you gain temporary HP equal to your monk level + Wisdom modifier.

hour-of-reaping-6.summary: As an action, creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a Wisdom save or be frightened until the end of your next turn.

mastery-of-death-11.summary: When you are reduced to 0 HP, you can spend 1 ki to drop to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.

mastery-of-death-17.summary: When you use Touch of Death, you regain hit points equal to the damage dealt.

radiant-sun-bolt-3.summary: You can make ranged spell attacks with a range of 30 feet dealing radiant damage. The damage scales with your monk level.

searing-arc-strike-6.summary: When you take the Attack action, you can spend 2 ki to cast burning hands.

searing-sunburst-11.summary: You can cast fireball without a spell slot by spending 4 ki. The damage increases by 1d6 for each additional ki point spent.

searing-sunburst-17.summary: Your radiant sun bolt range increases to 60 feet. When you hit with it, you can deal extra damage equal to your Wisdom modifier.

channel-divinity-sacred-weapon-3.summary: As an action, you can imbue one weapon with positive energy. For 1 minute, you add your Charisma modifier to attack rolls, and it emits bright light in a 20-foot radius.

channel-divinity-turn-the-unholy-3.summary: As an action, each fiend and undead within 30 feet must make a Wisdom save or be turned for 1 minute.

aura-of-devotion-7.summary: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet can't be charmed while you are conscious.

purity-of-spirit-15.summary: You are always under the effect of protection from evil and good. You have advantage on saves against spells.

holy-nimbus-20.summary: You emit bright light in a 30-foot radius. Enemies in the light take 10 radiant damage at the start of their turns. Enemy spellcasting in the light has disadvantage.

channel-divinity-natures-wrath-3.summary: As an action, you can cause vines to restrain creatures within 10 feet (Strength save). You can also use this to cause plants to entangle.

channel-divinity-turn-the-faithless-3.summary: As an action, each fey and fiend within 30 feet must make a Wisdom save or be turned for 1 minute.

aura-of-warding-7.summary: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet have resistance to damage from spells.

undying-sentinel-15.summary: When you drop to 0 HP, you instead drop to 1 HP and regain hit points equal to 2d6 + your level. Once per long rest.

elder-champion-20.summary: You regain 10 HP at the start of each turn. You can cast paladin spells with a bonus action. Enemies within 30 feet have disadvantage on saves against your spells.

channel-divinity-abjure-enemy-3.summary: As an action, choose one creature within 60 feet. It must make a Wisdom save or be frightened for 1 minute. It can repeat the save at the end of each turn.

channel-divinity-vow-of-enmity-3.summary: As a bonus action, you gain advantage on attack rolls against a creature within 10 feet for 1 minute.

relentless-avenger-7.summary: When you hit a creature with an opportunity attack, you can move up to half your speed as part of the reaction.

soul-of-vengeance-15.summary: When a creature you've marked with Vow of Enmity makes an attack, you can make a melee attack against it as a reaction.

avenging-angel-20.summary: You grow wings and gain a flying speed of 60 feet. You emanate an aura of menace. Creatures within 30 feet are frightened.

channel-divinity-champion-challenge-3.summary: As an action, you compel creatures within 30 feet to make a Wisdom save or be compelled to fight you.

channel-divinity-turn-the-tyrant-3.summary: As an action, you can force a creature to make a Wisdom save or be frightened for 1 minute.

divine-allegiance-7.summary: When a creature within 5 feet of you is hit by an attack, you can use your reaction to swap places and take the hit.

unwavering-mark-15.summary: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can mark it. It has disadvantage on attacks against others. You can make opportunity attacks against it at any distance.

exalted-champion-20.summary: You have advantage on saving throws. You can make an additional attack when you take the Attack action.

unwavering-mark-15.summary: When you hit a creature with a melee attack, you can mark it. It has disadvantage on attacks against others. You can make opportunity attacks against it at any distance.

fast-hands-3.summary: You can use the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves' tools, or take the Use an Object action.

second-story-work-3.summary: You can climb faster and jump farther. Climbing doesn't cost extra movement, and your running jump distance increases by your Dexterity modifier.

supreme-sneak-9.summary: You have advantage on Stealth checks if you move no more than half your speed on the same turn.

use-magic-device-13.summary: You can use any magic item regardless of class, race, or level requirements.

thiefs-reflexes-17.summary: You can take two turns during the first round of combat. Your second turn occurs after all other creatures have acted.

bonus-proficiencies-3.summary: You gain proficiency with the disguise kit and the poisoner's kit.

assassinate-3.summary: You have advantage on attack rolls against creatures that haven't taken a turn. Any hit against a surprised creature is a critical hit.

infiltration-expertise-9.summary: You can spend 1 hour and 25 gp to create a false identity. You can't be detected as an imposter by divination magic.

impostor-13.summary: You can spend 3 hours to adopt a persona. You gain advantage on Deception and Performance checks while maintaining it.

death-strike-17.summary: When you hit a surprised creature, it must make a Constitution save (DC 8 + proficiency + Dex) or take double damage.

spellcasting-3.summary: You learn three wizard cantrips (one must be mage hand) and three 1st-level wizard spells (enchantment and illusion). You are a 1/3 caster. Your spellcasting ability is Intelligence.

mage-hand-legerdemain-3.summary: You can make your mage hand invisible. You can stow objects in containers, retrieve objects, and use thieves' tools with it.

magical-ambush-9.summary: When you cast a spell on a creature unaware of you, it has disadvantage on the saving throw.

versatile-trickster-13.summary: As a bonus action, you can designate a creature within 30 feet. You have advantage on attack rolls against it.

spell-thief-17.summary: When a creature casts a spell targeting you, you can use your reaction to steal it (Intelligence save). You learn the spell and can cast it once.

fancy-footwork-3.summary: When you make a melee attack, you don't provoke opportunity attacks from the target. You can use a bonus action to move without provoking opportunity attacks.

rakish-audacity-3.summary: You add your Charisma modifier to Initiative. You gain Sneak Attack against isolated targets without needing advantage.

panache-9.summary: As an action, you can make a Charisma (Persuasion) check contested by a creature's Wisdom (Insight). On success, it has disadvantage on attacks against others and must target you.

elegant-maneuver-13.summary: You can use a bonus action to gain advantage on the next Acrobatics or Athletics check you make.

master-duelist-17.summary: When you miss with an attack, you can roll again with advantage. Once per short rest.

dragon-ancestor-1.summary: You choose a dragon type. You can speak, read, and write Draconic. You have resistance to the associated damage type.

draconic-resilience-1.summary: Your hit point maximum increases by 1 per sorcerer level. You have a base AC of 13 + Dexterity when not wearing armor.

elemental-affinity-6.summary: When you cast a spell that deals damage of your draconic ancestry's type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll. You can spend 1 sorcery point to gain resistance to that damage type for 1 hour.

dragon-wings-14.summary: You can use a bonus action to sprout dragon wings, gaining a flying speed equal to your walking speed. You can dismiss them as a bonus action.

draconic-presence-18.summary: As an action, you can spend 5 sorcery points to create a 60-foot aura of awe or fear (Charisma save).

wild-magic-surge-1.summary: When you cast a sorcerer spell of 1st level or higher, the DM can have you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

tides-of-chaos-1.summary: You can gain advantage on one attack roll, ability check, or saving throw. The DM can then make you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

bend-luck-6.summary: When a creature you can see makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can spend 1 sorcery point to add or subtract 1d4 from the roll.

controlled-chaos-14.summary: When you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table, you roll twice and choose either result.

tides-of-chaos-14.summary: You regain the use of Tides of Chaos when you roll on the Wild Magic Surge table.

divine-magic-1.summary: You learn cleric spells based on your divine affinity. They count as sorcerer spells but don't count against your spells known.

favored-by-the-gods-1.summary: When you fail a saving throw or attack roll, you can use your reaction to add 2d4 to the roll. Once per short rest.

empowered-healing-6.summary: When you roll dice to restore hit points, you can reroll any number of dice. You can use this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier per long rest.

otherworldly-wings-14.summary: As a bonus action, you can manifest spectral wings and gain a flying speed of 30 feet for 1 minute.

unearthly-recovery-18.summary: At the end of your turn, if you have fewer than half your hit points, you regain hit points equal to half your sorcerer level.

eyes-of-the-dark-1.summary: You have 120-foot darkvision. You can cast darkness by spending 2 sorcery points.

strength-of-the-grave-1.summary: When you drop to 0 HP, you can make a Charisma save (DC 5 + damage taken) to drop to 1 HP instead. Once per long rest.

hound-of-ill-omen-6.summary: As a bonus action, you can summon a hound of ill omen (dire wolf) that attacks a target. It has HP equal to 5 × your sorcerer level.

shadow-walk-14.summary: As a bonus action in dim light or darkness, you can teleport up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

shadow-form-18.summary: As an action, you become a shadow. You gain resistance to all damage except force and radiant, and can move through creatures and objects.

wind-speaker-1.summary: You can speak, read, and write Primordial. You know the gust cantrip and can cast it without a spell slot.

tempestuous-magic-1.summary: After you cast a spell of 1st level or higher, you can fly 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

heart-of-the-storm-6.summary: When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that deals lightning or thunder damage, you can fly 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

storm-guide-6.summary: You can't get lost, and you have advantage on saves against lightning and thunder. You can reduce fall damage to 0.

storms-fury-14.summary: When you are hit by a melee attack, the attacker takes lightning damage equal to your sorcerer level. You can fly 30 feet without provoking.

wind-soul-18.summary: You gain immunity to lightning and thunder damage. You gain a flying speed of 60 feet and can grant a 30-foot fly speed to up to 10 allies for 1 hour.

fey-presence-1.summary: As an action, you can force each creature within 10 feet to make a Wisdom save or be charmed or frightened until the end of your next turn.

misty-escape-6.summary: When you take damage, you can use your reaction to turn invisible and teleport up to 60 feet. You can't do this again until you finish a short or long rest.

beguiling-defenses-10.summary: You are immune to being charmed. When another creature tries to charm you, you can use your reaction to turn it back on them.

dark-delirium-14.summary: As an action, you can banish a creature within 60 feet to an illusory realm (Wisdom save). It returns at the end of your next turn.

dark-ones-blessing-1.summary: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP, you gain temporary HP equal to your Charisma modifier + your warlock level.

dark-ones-own-luck-6.summary: When you make an ability check or saving throw, you can add 1d10 to the roll. Once per short rest.

fiendish-resilience-10.summary: As a bonus action, you can gain resistance to a damage type of your choice for 1 hour (once per short rest).

hurl-through-hell-14.summary: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can banish it to the Lower Planes until the end of your next turn (once per long rest).

awakened-mind-1.summary: You can communicate telepathically with any creature within 30 feet that you can see.

entropic-ward-6.summary: When a creature makes an attack roll against you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage. Once per short rest.

thought-shield-10.summary: You are immune to psychic damage, and your thoughts can't be read. When you take psychic damage, the attacker takes the same amount.

create-thrall-14.summary: As an action, you can touch an incapacitated humanoid to charm it permanently (Wisdom save). You can have one thrall at a time.

hexblades-curse-1.summary: As a bonus action, you can curse a creature within 30 feet for 1 minute. You add your proficiency bonus to damage against it. You regain HP equal to your warlock level when it dies.

hex-warrior-1.summary: You gain proficiency with medium armor, shields, and martial weapons. You can use Charisma for attack and damage rolls with one weapon.

accolades-6.summary: You gain a +1 bonus to AC and saving throws while not wearing armor. You gain proficiency with medium armor and shields.

master-of-hex-14.summary: You can move your Hex to a new target as a bonus action. You can apply Hex to multiple creatures.

arcane-ward-2.summary: When you cast an abjuration spell of 1st level or higher, you create a magical ward with HP equal to twice your wizard level + Intelligence modifier. The ward takes damage for you.

projected-ward-6.summary: When a creature within 30 feet takes damage, you can use your reaction to have your Arcane Ward take the damage instead.

improved-arcane-ward-10.summary: When you cast an abjuration spell, your Arcane Ward regains HP equal to the spell's level + your Intelligence modifier.

spell-resistance-14.summary: You have advantage on saving throws against spells and resistance to spell damage.

minor-conjuration-2.summary: You can use an action to conjure a nonmagical object up to 3 feet in size, 10 lbs. It disappears after 1 hour or when you dismiss it.

benign-transposition-6.summary: As an action, you can teleport up to 30 feet, swapping places with a willing creature or moving an object.

focused-conjuration-10.summary: You can't lose concentration on conjuration spells from taking damage.

durable-summons-14.summary: Creatures you summon have maximum hit points and are difficult to dispel.

portent-2.summary: After a long rest, roll two d20s. You can replace any attack roll, saving throw, or ability check with one of these rolls.

expert-divination-6.summary: When you cast a divination spell of 2nd level or higher, you regain one expended spell slot of a lower level.

third-eye-10.summary: As an action, you gain one of: darkvision 60 ft, ethereal sight 60 ft, see invisible 10 ft, or read languages. Lasts until you rest.

greater-portent-14.summary: You roll three d20s for Portent instead of two.

hypnotic-gaze-2.summary: As an action, you can charm a creature within 5 feet (Wisdom save). It is incapacitated and has speed 0. You must maintain concentration.

instinctive-charm-6.summary: When a creature within 30 feet attacks you, you can use your reaction to force it to attack another target (Wisdom save).

split-enchantment-10.summary: When you cast an enchantment spell on one target, you can target a second creature within 30 feet.

alter-memories-14.summary: You can cast modify memory without a spell slot. The target has no memory of the change.

evocation-savant-2.summary: The gold and time to copy evocation spells is halved.

sculpt-spells-2.summary: When you cast an evocation spell, you can choose up to 1 + spell level creatures to automatically succeed on saves.

potent-cantrip-6.summary: When a creature succeeds on a save against your cantrip, it still takes half damage.

empowered-evocation-10.summary: You add your Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of any evocation spell you cast.

overchannel-14.summary: When you cast a wizard spell of 1st-5th level, you can maximize its damage. First use is free; subsequent uses deal necrotic damage to you.

improved-minor-illusion-2.summary: You learn the minor illusion cantrip. You can create both a sound and an image with it.

malleable-illusions-6.summary: You can change the nature of an illusion spell you cast (e.g., turn an image into a sound).

illusionary-reality-14.summary: When you cast an illusion spell of 1st level or higher, you can make one inanimate object in the illusion real for 1 minute.

grim-harvest-2.summary: When you kill a creature with a spell, you regain HP equal to twice the spell's level (three times for necromancy).

undead-thralls-6.summary: You can animate dead as an action. It creates one extra skeleton/zombie, and they have extra HP and damage.

inure-to-death-10.summary: You have resistance to necrotic damage. Your hit point maximum can't be reduced.

command-undead-14.summary: As an action, you can command an undead within 60 feet (Charisma save). It obeys you for 24 hours.

transmuters-stone-2.summary: You create a transmuter's stone granting one of: darkvision 60 ft, +10 speed, proficiency in Con saves, or resistance to acid/cold/fire/lightning/poison.

shapechanger-6.summary: You can cast polymorph on yourself without a spell slot. You revert at the end of your next turn.

master-transmuter-14.summary: You can destroy your transmuter's stone to: restore all HP, end a condition, restore a transmutation spell slot, or raise someone from the dead.
